title: Generate Once Versus Generate for Each Student
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Compare the yearly cost of generating a textbook once and serving it to everyone with generating content live for each student, and find the break-even number of students.

learningObjectives: The learner will compare the total yearly cost of generating content once and serving it to all students with the cost of generating it live for each student, and determine the number of students at which the two are equal, to within 100 students.
prerequisites: Generate once serve many and web page hosting (Chapter 9), and AI inference cost (Chapter 4).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Calculate points, then locate the break-even on a chart
keyQuestions: Which cost is fixed and which grows with students?
Where do the two lines cross?
commonMisconceptions: Live generation is always more expensive
Serving static pages costs as much as generating them
The cost of generate-once grows with the number of students
assessmentOpportunities: Generate-once cost per student for 12,000 students?
Live total for 12,000 students at $7.20 each?
Does the generate-once total grow with students?
